what_I_did_NOT_do: I did not edit the briefing to make the audit pass. The agent read that file as written and its verdict is downstream of that exact text; rewriting it now would be falsifying the record, which is worse than a red audit.
FIX_FOR_FUTURE_BRIEFINGS: never write the closing CLOCK TIME of an in-progress higher-timeframe bar. Write the duration instead - 'the 15m bar in progress does not close for another nine minutes' - which conveys the same thing and does not trip check C. A better long-term fix is for check C to whitelist a bar-in-progress phrasing, but tightening the briefing is the safer of the two and needs no change to the gate.

If he disagrees, the day is re-runnable - nothing else in this log depends on that briefing.
